main_text.p: m.p. Robusti, Validi. Hebraei plerique coloris alicujus speciem significare existimant, unde Chald. קטמין Cinerei.

אמר Dixit, Locutus est: cum ad cor & mentem refertur, est, Cogitare, Statuere, Proponere. Chald. אמר Dixit: אמרת Dixi, אמרנא Diximus. Partic. אמר Dicens, pro אמר, Dan. 4. 4. אמרין Dicentes. Infin. למאמר, לממר Dicendo. Imper. אמר Dic, אמרו Dicite. Futurum יאמר Dicet, תאמרון Dicetis. Niphal, נאמר Dici. Hiphil, האמירך Fecit dicere te, Effecit ut promiseris & spoponderis, Sponsionem stipulatus est a te, Deuter. 26. 18: sic האמרת, ibid. verf. 17. Hithpahel, Futur. יתאמרו Verbis praedicabunt, efferent vel elevabunt se, Psal. 94. 4: תתימרו Summè praedicabitis vos, Efferetis vos, Jes. 01. 6, cum loco א.
מאמר אמרה אמר, Chald. מאמר, Sermo, Oratio, Edictum.
אמרא אמר Chald. Agnus: plur. אמרין.

page.notes: Hebrew headword and entries are reproduced as legible; some vowel points and Hebrew forms are uncertain in the scan, particularly in the middle of the entry "אמר", and may contain small errors. The word "pro" before the Hebrew at "pro אמר" and the mark "א" after "loco" are as printed.
